content.text: Latency jumped from ~45ms/220ms to 1545ms/1720ms p50/p95 exactly at 23:41:00Z, coinciding with logs showing "slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms" for basket-total. No deploys/changes recorded in the window. The dependency register shows io-pricing is internal, owned by checkout-platform (same organisation).

hypotheses.subject: io-pricing
hypotheses.summary: io-pricing (pricing.io-internal.svc), an internal dependency owned by checkout-platform, began responding slowly (~1500ms) to basket-total calls right at the onset, and io-shop's p50/p95/p99 latency jumped in lockstep from ~45/220/380ms to ~1545/1720/1870ms. No deploy or config change occurred on io-shop itself in this window, so the fault arrived through the dependency rather than originating locally.

supporting_evidence.claim: 2026-09-25T23:41:00Z WARN io-shop: slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms for /v1/shoppers/shopper-21938-5-2/basket-total (139 of 200 requests)
2026-09-25T23:42:00Z WARN io-shop: slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms for /v1/shoppers/shopper-57748-12-0/basket-total (200 of 200 requests)
io-pricing: internal, owned by checkout-platform, at pricing.io-internal.svc - What a shopper's basket comes to once their discounts are applied. Called while the account page renders
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-25T21:00:00Z to 2026-09-25T23:46:18Z. (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.subject: io-pricing
hypotheses.summary: If io-pricing were in fact operated by an external party rather than checkout-platform, this same slowdown would instead be an upstream-dependency-failure; the register, however, states it is internally owned, so this is offered only as a fallback.
